006292: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_preprocess_pragma_macro_name(char8 const* base, CToken* tokens, u32 token_count, String8* name_out)
006293: {
006294:     if (token_count == 4 && tokens[0].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
006295:         tokens[2].kind == C_TOKEN_STRING_LITERAL && tokens[2].length >= 2 && c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[3], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
006296:     {
006297:         String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(base, tokens[2]);
006298:         *name_out = (String8){
006299:             .pointer = spelling.pointer + 1,
006300:             .length = spelling.length - 2,
006301:         };
006302:         return true;
006303:     }
006304:     return false;
006305: }

006307: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_macro_push_definition(CPreprocessPragmaContext context, String8 name)
006308: {
006309:     CMacro* macro = c_macro_find(*context.first_macro, c_symbol_intern(context.symbols, name));
006310:     CMacroPushMacro* entry = arena_allocate(context.arena, CMacroPushMacro, 1);
006311:     *entry = (CMacroPushMacro){
006312:         .previous = *context.macro_push_stack,
006313:         .macro = macro,
006314:         .name = string_duplicate_arena(context.arena, name, false),
006315:         .definition = macro ? macro->definition : (CMacroDefinition){0},
006316:     };
006317:     if (macro && macro->definition.replacement_count)
006318:     {
006319:         entry->definition.replacement = arena_allocate(context.arena, CToken, macro->definition.replacement_count);
006320:         memcpy(entry->definition.replacement, macro->definition.replacement,
006321:                sizeof(*entry->definition.replacement) * macro->definition.replacement_count);
006322:         if (macro->definition.replacement_space)
006323:         {
006324:             entry->definition.replacement_space = arena_allocate(context.arena, u8, macro->definition.replacement_count);
006325:             memcpy(entry->definition.replacement_space, macro->definition.replacement_space,
006326:                    sizeof(*entry->definition.replacement_space) * macro->definition.replacement_count);
006327:         }
006328:         entry->definition.parameter_index = arena_allocate(context.arena, u32, macro->definition.replacement_count);
006329:         memcpy(entry->definition.parameter_index, macro->definition.parameter_index,
006330:                sizeof(*entry->definition.parameter_index) * macro->definition.replacement_count);
006331:     }
006332:     if (macro && macro->definition.parameter_count)
006333:     {
006334:         entry->definition.parameters = arena_allocate(context.arena, String8, macro->definition.parameter_count);
006335:         memcpy(entry->definition.parameters, macro->definition.parameters,
006336:                sizeof(*entry->definition.parameters) * macro->definition.parameter_count);
006337:         entry->definition.parameter_use_count = arena_allocate(context.arena, u32, macro->definition.parameter_count);
006338:         memcpy(entry->definition.parameter_use_count, macro->definition.parameter_use_count,
006339:                sizeof(*entry->definition.parameter_use_count) * macro->definition.parameter_count);
006340:     }
006341:     *context.macro_push_stack = entry;
006342: }

006344: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_macro_clear_definition(CMacro* macro)
006345: {
006346:     if (!macro)
006347:     {
006348:         return;
006349:     }
006350:     macro->definition = (CMacroDefinition){0};

006353: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_macro_pop_definition(CPreprocessPragmaContext context, String8 name)
006354: {
006355:     CMacroPushMacro** cursor = context.macro_push_stack;
006356:     while (*cursor && !string_equal((*cursor)->name, name))
006357:     {
006358:         cursor = &(*cursor)->previous;
006359:     }
006360:     if (!(!*cursor))
006361:     {
006362:         CMacroPushMacro* entry = *cursor;
006363:         *cursor = entry->previous;
006364:         if (!entry->macro)
006365:         {
006366:             c_macro_clear_definition(c_macro_find(*context.first_macro, c_symbol_intern(context.symbols, name)));
006367:             return;
006368:         }
006369:         CMacro* macro = entry->macro;
006370:         macro->definition = entry->definition;
006371:         macro->disabled = false;
006372:     }
006373: }

006375: // The bound is UINT16_MAX because CToken carries the alignment in a u16, and
006376: // no ABI has a structure alignment that large to begin with.
006377: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_preprocess_pragma_pack_value(char8 const* base, CToken token, u16* value_out)
006378: {
006379:     u64 value = 0;
006380:     bool valid =
006381:         token.kind == C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER && c_conditional_number(c_token_spelling(base, token), &value) && value <= UINT16_MAX && value && !(value & (value - 1));
006382:     if (valid)
006383:     {
006384:         *value_out = (u16)value;
006385:     }
006386:     return valid;
006387: }

006389: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_preprocess_pragma_pack(CPreprocessPragmaContext context, char8 const* base, CToken* tokens, u32 token_count)
006390: {
006391:     if (token_count < 3 || tokens[0].kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER || !c_token_spelling_equal(base, tokens[0], S8("pack")) ||
006392:         !c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) || !c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[token_count - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
006393:     {
006394:         return;
006395:     }
006396:     CToken* arguments = tokens + 2;
006397:     u32 argument_count = token_count - 3;
006398:     if (!argument_count)
006399:     {
006400:         *context.pack_alignment = 0;
006401:         return;
006402:     }
006403:     bool push = argument_count >= 1 && arguments[0].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && c_token_spelling_equal(base, arguments[0], S8("push"));
006404:     bool pop = argument_count >= 1 && arguments[0].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && c_token_spelling_equal(base, arguments[0], S8("pop"));
006405:     u32 value_index = UINT32_MAX;
006406:     if (push)
006407:     {
006408:         if (argument_count == 1)
006409:         {
006410:             value_index = UINT32_MAX;
006411:         }
006412:         else if (argument_count == 3 && c_token_is_punctuator(&arguments[1], C_PUNCTUATOR_COMMA))
006413:         {
006414:             value_index = 2;
006415:         }
006416:         else if (argument_count == 5 && c_token_is_punctuator(&arguments[1], C_PUNCTUATOR_COMMA) && arguments[2].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER &&
006417:                  c_token_is_punctuator(&arguments[3], C_PUNCTUATOR_COMMA))
006418:         {
006419:             value_index = 4;
006420:         }
006421:         else
006422:         {
006423:             return;
006424:         }
006425:         u16 value = 0;
006426:         bool valid_value = value_index != UINT32_MAX && c_preprocess_pragma_pack_value(base, arguments[value_index], &value);
006427:         if (value_index != UINT32_MAX && !valid_value)
006428:         {
006429:             return;
006430:         }
006431:         CPragmaPackStack* entry = arena_allocate(context.arena, CPragmaPackStack, 1);
006432:         *entry = (CPragmaPackStack){
006433:             .previous = *context.pack_stack,
006434:             .alignment = *context.pack_alignment,
006435:         };
006436:         *context.pack_stack = entry;
006437:         if (valid_value)
006438:         {
006439:             *context.pack_alignment = value;
006440:         }
006441:         return;
006442:     }
006443:     if (pop)
006444:     {
006445:         if (argument_count != 1 &&
006446:             !(argument_count == 3 && c_token_is_punctuator(&arguments[1], C_PUNCTUATOR_COMMA) && arguments[2].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER))
006447:         {
006448:             return;
006449:         }
006450:         if (*context.pack_stack)
006451:         {
006452:             *context.pack_alignment = (*context.pack_stack)->alignment;
006453:             *context.pack_stack = (*context.pack_stack)->previous;
006454:         }
006455:         return;
006456:     }
006457:     if (argument_count == 1)
006458:     {
006459:         u16 value = 0;
006460:         if (c_preprocess_pragma_pack_value(base, arguments[0], &value))
006461:         {
006462:             *context.pack_alignment = value;
006463:         }
006464:     }
006465: }

006467: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_preprocess_handle_pragma(CPreprocessPragmaContext context, char8 const* base, CToken* tokens, u32 token_count)
006468: {
006469:     if (token_count)
006470:     {
006471:         if (token_count == 1 && tokens[0].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && c_token_spelling_equal(base, tokens[0], S8("once")))
006472:         {
006473:             CIncludeFileEntry* entry = 0;
006474:             CIncludeFileStatus status =
006475:                 c_include_file_entry(context.include_files, context.current_identity, context.current_path, &entry);
006476:             if (status == C_INCLUDE_FILE_OK)
006477:             {
006478:                 entry->once = true;
006479:             }
006480:             else
006481:             {
006482:                 c_include_file_diagnostic(context.arena, context.preprocess, context.current_location, status, context.current_path);
006483:             }
006484:             return;
006485:         }
006486:         if (tokens[0].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && c_token_spelling_equal(base, tokens[0], S8("push_macro")))
006487:         {
006488:             String8 name = {0};
006489:             if (c_preprocess_pragma_macro_name(base, tokens, token_count, &name))
006490:             {
006491:                 c_macro_push_definition(context, name);
006492:             }
006493:             return;
006494:         }
006495:         if (tokens[0].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && c_token_spelling_equal(base, tokens[0], S8("pop_macro")))
006496:         {
006497:             String8 name = {0};
006498:             if (c_preprocess_pragma_macro_name(base, tokens, token_count, &name))
006499:             {
006500:                 c_macro_pop_definition(context, name);
006501:             }
006502:             return;
006503:         }
006504:         if (tokens[0].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER && c_token_spelling_equal(base, tokens[0], S8("pack")))
006505:         {
006506:             c_preprocess_pragma_pack(context, base, tokens, token_count);
006507:         }
006508:         // GCC/Clang/MSVC diagnostic, visibility, system-header, warning,
006509:         // comment, region, and OpenMP pragmas are compatibility no-ops. Unknown
006510:         // pragma bodies are intentionally ignored as well.
006511:     }
006512: }

006514: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_preprocess_pragma_marker(CPreprocessPragmaContext context, char8 const* base, CToken marker)
006515: {
006516:     if (!marker.length)
006517:     {
006518:         return;
006519:     }
006520:     // The marker relex is standalone: its tokens' offsets are relative to its
006521:     // own translated copy, so the handler reads them through that base.
006522:     CLexResult lex = c_lex(context.arena, c_token_spelling(base, marker));
006523:     u32 token_count = 0;
006524:     while (token_count < lex.token_count && lex.tokens[token_count].kind != C_TOKEN_NEWLINE && lex.tokens[token_count].kind != C_TOKEN_END_OF_FILE)
006525:     {
006526:         token_count += 1;
006527:     }
006528:     c_preprocess_handle_pragma(context, lex.spelling_base, lex.tokens, token_count);
006529: }

006531: // Materialize an expanded line into the output stream. Foreign tokens (their
006532: // location is a macro-invocation stamp, not a function of their spelling
006533: // offset) get their spellings copied to fresh space offsets under an
006534: // expansion source-map entry; one invocation's tokens share one stamped
006535: // location, so runs of equal locations share one entry.
006536: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_preprocess_process_expanded_line(CPreprocessPragmaContext context, CSpellingSpace* space, CSourceMap* map,
006537:                                                             CPpStampTable const* stamps, CPreprocessTokenNode* first_line, u64 line_output_count,
006538:                                                             CTokenStream* token_stream, u64* output_count)
006539: {
006540:     CTokenShape* shapes = 0;
006541:     CToken* tokens = c_token_stream_reserve(token_stream, line_output_count, &shapes);
006542:     u64 count = 0;
006543:     u64 foreign_length = 0;
006544:     for (CPreprocessTokenNode* node = first_line; node; node = node->next)
006545:     {
006546:         foreign_length += node->token.foreign ? c_token_length(space->base, node->token.token) : 0;
006547:     }
006548:     char8* copy = foreign_length ? c_space_allocate(space, foreign_length) : 0;
006549:     bool run_open = false;
006550:     // Every stamp of a line is pushed from a distinct token, so two tokens
006551:     // carry one location exactly when they carry one stamp.
006552:     u32 run_stamp = 0;
006553:     // The pack alignment can only change where a pragma marker fires, so the
006554:     // sample is taken at the line's first token and again at the first token
006555:     // after each marker, instead of asking the recorder once per token.
006556:     bool pack_pending = true;
006557:     for (CPreprocessTokenNode* node = first_line; node; node = node->next)
006558:     {
006559:         if (node->token.token.kind == C_TOKEN_PRAGMA)
006560:         {
006561:             context.current_location = c_pp_stamp_location(stamps, node->token.stamp);
